text:
Cook Architecture is a small residential studio in Northern Virginia focused on modern new homes, residential additions and renovations, and updating and expanding midcentury-modern houses. Our projects are design-driven, but the work does not stop at the concept. We care just as much about how buildings are detailed and how they are ultimately built.
We are hiring an experienced architect or architectural designer to take an active role in their own projects. You will help develop the schematic design for presentation, then carry the work through construction documents, permitting, and into the field. You will work closely with the principal on design and have real ownership of the work as it develops. We’re looking for someone who enjoys the point where architecture becomes buildable, and where design decisions are resolved through drawings and details. Salary depends heavily on experience and skill, with real growth as you learn and take on more.
One of the advantages of our small studio is getting to see the whole arc of a project. You will be involved from the first client presentation through the punch list, working directly with clients, consultants, and contractors along the way. If you are working toward licensure, the work here covers the full range of AXP experience, and we will support you through the process.
What you will do
How we work
You will work directly with the principal architect and the rest of our small team. Drawing reviews often happen together at your desk, in real time, so there is plenty of opportunity to talk through design and technical decisions as the work develops.
It’s an active, collaborative studio. People think out loud, and priorities sometimes shift during the day.
What we’re looking for
To apply
Apply on Archinect or email [email protected] with the subject line “Project Architect: [your name].” No phone calls please. Include a resume, a portfolio in a single PDF under 15 MB or as a link, and one drawing you produced yourself. It can be a wall section, stair detail, window head, or anything else that shows us how you think about construction. 
Please include your salary expectations in the email.
